about_the_game:
Finding yourself in a gloomy and abandoned hospital, it's up to you to find a way out of this place creeping with the horrors of the past. Hide, explore, collect useful items - and be careful: you are not alone here.

You wake up in the dark corridors of an abandoned hospital with no idea how you got here. Your only goal is to get out. But it's not that simple. There is something sinister roaming this gloomy location, and it will not miss the opportunity to catch you.

Explore every nook and cranny to unravel the mystery of what happened and figure out how to get out. You'll find an oppressive atmosphere, tense gameplay and a constant feeling of being chased. Hide, turn off noise sources, distract the monster and make decisions with a cool head.

Game Features:

- Atmospheric stylized graphics

- Exploring a mysterious location

- Hide-and-seek and survival under pressure

- Exciting story with investigative elements

- Hostile monster reacting to the player's actions
